title: i18n analysis
noData: Run the scan to list hard-coded text and missing translations.

errors.noProject: Select a project before running a scan.

description: Finds hard-coded UI text (JSX, Vue, Angular, Razor, XAML, Flutter, SwiftUI, Compose, Android layouts…) and compares every locale with the reference one, whatever the catalog format: JSON, RESX, ARB, XLIFF, Android strings.xml, iOS .strings, gettext, .properties, Rails YAML, Laravel.
